title: VeraCrypt
summary: Open-source disk-encryption software based on TrueCrypt.
whyThisMatters: VeraCrypt became a prominent continuation option after TrueCrypt development ended. It has kept disk-encryption implementation and audit questions visible to a broad user community.

sections.overview:
VeraCrypt is disk-encryption software based on TrueCrypt.

Design

Its documentation describes encrypted volumes, system encryption, keyfiles, and hidden-volume features.

The project documents support and migration considerations for particular TrueCrypt formats and versions.

Role

VeraCrypt is one of the best-known community-maintained tools in the post-TrueCrypt disk-encryption landscape.

timeline.event: VeraCrypt is documented as a security tool.
